Class ProfileAssetService

java.lang.Object
com.example.tarecruitment.profile.service.ProfileAssetService
public class ProfileAssetService extends Object
ProfileAssetService - TA profile attachment service. Responsible for saving, locating, deleting and assembling response information for resume, resume draft, and photo files. Externally only returns relative paths (e.g., resumes/xxx.pdf), real root directory is determined by TA_HIRING_DATA_DIR.

    • copyDraftResumeToFinal

      public String copyDraftResumeToFinal(String draftRelativePath, String userId, String originalFileName) throws IOException

    • storeDraftResumeState

      public void storeDraftResumeState(jakarta.servlet.http.HttpSession session, String draftResumePath, String originalFileName)
      Store draft resume info to current session. This type of state does not enter CSV, because user may only upload file but not yet saved profile form.

    • clearDraftResumeState

      public void clearDraftResumeState(jakarta.servlet.http.HttpSession session, boolean deleteFile)
      Clear draft resume session state. deleteFile=true for cancel/save complete scenario, to avoid abandoned draft occupying data directory for long.
